    candidates = [
        "rate_limiter", "ratelimiter", "token_bucket", "tokenbucket",
        "limiter", "rate_limit", "ratelimit", "module", "solution", "main",
    ]
    for name in candidates:
        try:

        except Exception:
            continue
        if hasattr(mod, "RateLimiter"):
            return mod.RateLimiter
    skip = {"test_generated", "conftest"}
    for info in pkgutil.iter_modules(dirs):
        if info.name in skip or info.name.startswith("test") or info.name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:

        except Exception:
            continue

            return mod.RateLimiter
    raise ImportError("could not locate module defining RateLimiter")
